correctness.rationale: For the stationary Markov-modulated OU with on-state drift -kX and symmetric jump rate q, stationary second-moment generator equations give m_(2,1)=D/k, m_(2,0)=D/k+D/q. The covariance C(t)=m_2^T exp((Q-K)t)1 satisfies the second-order ODE C-double-prime + (k+2q) C-prime + (kq) C = 0 with C(0)=D(k+2q)/(kq) and C-prime(0+)=-D. In particular, right derivatives give C"(0+)=0, C-third=DP, C-fourth=-DPL. Hence the full covariance determines D,P=kq,L=k+2q, and k,2q are the two positive roots of z²−L z+2P. They produce exactly original rates and their involution (q,k,D)↦(k/2,2q,D), equal only on k=2q. Stationary fourth-moment equations give kappa4=D²(9/q²+6/(qk)); the involutive difference 9D²(1/q²−4/k²) is nonzero off the fixed line and q=3D/sqrt(kappa4−6D²/P). Independently verified generator moment solutions, derivative invariants and twin difference symbolically; an exact stationary covariance does not imply practical finite-noise estimability.
